exposure: ICD-10 diagnostic codes for hypothyroidism (E02, E03, E89.0)
outcome: thyrotropin (TSH) test evaluation rate during the first trimester
cohort: The study included 5,574 pregnant women with known hypothyroidism identified from 111,811 pregnancies registered in primary care in Catalonia between 2014 and 2016.
finding: TSH testing was not performed in almost half of the pregnant women with known hypothyroidism during the first trimester, and among those tested, over two-thirds had TSH levels outside the target range.
cross-section timing: TSH evaluation during the first trimester of pregnancy; data collected from pregnancies between 2014 and 2016.
